blocks.title: WHAT IS DEVFEST?
blocks.content: A tech conference built by the community, for the community. No sales pitches on stage: concrete technical projects, hands-on workshops, and the people who actually built them. From the first DevFest Montreal in 2017 to 400+ developers last year, 2026 is our 8th and most ambitious edition yet.

blocks.title: WHO'S BEHIND IT?
blocks.content: The GDGs (Google Developer Groups): local, volunteer-run communities of developers who meet all year to learn, build and grow together.

blocks.title: THE VENUE
blocks.content: Ax.c Hub, a great event space at 800 Square-Victoria, downtown Montreal, right on top of the Square-Victoria-OACI metro. Several rooms, all under one roof.
